subject: GCP co-sell: PM checkpoint + joint pipeline sync (Acme Health)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: gcp-pm-team@google.com, Shelley Nguyen <shelley@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: GCP co-sell: PM checkpoint + joint pipeline sync (Acme Health)

Hi all,

Following up from last week's intake: Acme Health has expressed high intent to list on GCP marketplace and pursue a co-sell path with a pilot in Q4. I attached a short account brief and a checklist that captures current blockers.

Primary asks:
- Can GCP confirm the partner manager who will own the co-sell for this account?
- Can we lock a 45-minute sync next week to finalize the mutual action plan (MAP) and clarify listing requirements?

Suggested agenda:
1) Intros / roles (5m)
2) Current ACV & pilot scope (10m)
3) Listing readiness items and blockers (15m)
4) Co-sell GTM cadence + docs (10m)
5) Actions / owners (5m)

Proposed times (PDT): Thu 8/13 10:00 or Fri 8/14 09:00 — please reply with availability.

Attachments: acme_joint_account_brief.pdf (summary), gcp_listing_readiness_checklist.xlsx (blockers).

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Product Manager, Marketplace Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Shelley Nguyen <shelley@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell: PM checkpoint + joint pipeline sync (Acme Health)

Hi Karthik — thanks for the note and the brief.

We're keen to move this forward. I can make Fri 8/14 09:00 PDT. Tom (cc'd) is our commercial lead and will join for the MAP discussion. A couple of items from our side before the sync:
- We need clarity on billing model options for marketplace listing (pay-as-you-go vs committed).
- Security questionnaire: which line items would trigger a private deployment requirement vs hosted?

I'll review the checklist and flag anything else. See you Friday.

Best,
Shelley
Head of Product Partnerships
Acme Health

Subject: Re: GCP co-sell: PM checkpoint + joint pipeline sync (Acme Health)

Thanks Shelley — Fri 09:00 PDT works for me too. I can cover the GTM ask and marketplace listing process (brief walkthrough + required artifacts).

Notes for the sync:
- Please have your procurement contact available or forward billing-contact details ahead of time — listing often stalls there.
- We'll bring a draft MOU for scope/credits; I'll drop a DocuSign link after the call for signatures if we land the MAP.

I'll prepare a one-slide handoff for the co-sell steps.

On Fri, Aug 14, 2026 at 07:12 AM PDT Jonas Weber wrote:
> Thanks Shelley — Fri 09:00 PDT works for me too. I can cover the GTM ask and marketplace listing process (brief walkthrough + required artifacts).

Quick ops notes for everyone before 09:00:
- I updated the attached checklist with the current status (red/amber/green). Key blockers:
  * Billing contact (still missing) — procurement needs to confirm GCP billing account and contract owner.
  * Security evidence gap — Acme's InfoSec asked for SOC 2 Type II report and data retention terms; they also have a requirement around private deployment for PHI test environments.
  * Listing metadata — we need final product description and pricing SKU mapping by next Tue to hit the Q4 listing window.

Attachments: acme_mutual_action_plan.docx (draft MAP).

I'll bring a short ops checklist to the meeting and can own follow-ups on the listing intake.

-Marissa

Thanks everyone for the quick replies and for confirming the slot. Final agenda for 09:00 PDT:
- Intros & roles (5m) — Jonas to lead
- Pilot scope & success metrics (10m) — Acme + Jonas
- Listing readiness: billing / security / metadata (15m) — Marissa to lead ops
- Co-sell motion & GTM support from GCP (10m) — GCP PM
- MAP finalization & next steps (5m) — Karthik to capture owners

Action items assigned during meeting: please expect
- Acme: billing contact + final product blurb (due Tue 8/18)
- Redwood (Marissa): collect security evidence inventory and propose temporary private-test-workflow options
- Redwood (Jonas): draft MOU and share DocuSign for signature if MAP agreed

I'll send a calendar invite with the dial-in and attach the latest checklist and MAP shortly. Looking forward to aligning.
